note: P4393 (Pro 31:18) — she perceives that her trade is profitable; her lamp does not go out at night.

dims.v: discerning diligence — sensing her venture prospers, she works on into the night

the perceiving that her merchandise is profitable, so that her lamp does not go out at night — the discerning judgement that senses a venture is prospering, joined to the tireless diligence that presses on late to make the most of it
the discernment that reads her venture's worth and the diligence that works late upon it

taam (taste/perceive) — 'she PERCEIVES that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp does not go out at night' (31:18); she has a discerning sense for what prospers and the diligence to labour late upon it. Discernment and tireless industry together make her enterprise thrive.
